name.description: Optional. Name of the SerDe. The maximum length is 256 characters.

parameters.description: Optional. Key-value pairs that define the initialization parameters for the serialization library. Maximum size 10 Kib.

serializationLibrary.description: Required. Specifies a fully-qualified class name of the serialization library that is responsible for the translation of data between table representation and the underlying low-level input and output format structures. The maximum length is 256 characters.
